heading.title: National Company Law Tribunal and Appellate Tribunal

article.title: Limitation.
article.content: The provisions of the Limitation Act, 1963 (36 of 1963) shall, as far as may be, apply to proceedings or appeals before the Tribunal or the Appellate Tribunal, as the case maybe.
article.html:
433Limitation.

Section 433 · Chapter XXVII · page 239 of the Act

The provisions of the Limitation Act, 1963 (36 of 1963) shall, as far as may be, apply to proceedings or appeals before the Tribunal or the Appellate Tribunal, as the case maybe.
